summary: SciSparc Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K on October 7, 2026, attaching a press release from majority-owned subsidiary NeuroThera Labs, whose CliniQuantum unit reported a GPU-accelerated quantum-simulation benchmark achieving roughly 16.8-fold speedup over CPU on an AWS g4dn.16xlarge instance with an NVIDIA T4 GPU. The analysis processed a real clinical gene-expression dataset of 11 patients and 3,531 features, evaluating 7.33 billion three-gene combinations in about 0.5 hours versus 8.4 hours on CPU. No transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed. The filing is a routine product/technology update, not a special situation. Watch for subsequent clinical or corporate actions that could convert the disclosure stream into a deal event.
